# Gamdl GUI 1.0.0

The first release of the rewritten Gamdl GUI. The whole interface was moved from
the original `customtkinter` script to **PySide6 (Qt)** and reworked around
**gamdl 3.x**, and the app now ships as a self-contained bundle that needs no
Python and no `gamdl` installation.

## Highlights

**A real desktop UI.** Native Qt widgets, a resizable three-pane layout, a
dark / light / system theme, and a coloured console that renders gamdl's ANSI
log inline with a reliable progress bar and current-track label.

**Sign in without leaving the app.** The old workflow made you export
`cookies.txt` from a browser. There is now a built-in **Sign in to Apple Music**
button that opens the OS webview (WKWebView on macOS, WebView2 on Windows), lets
you log in normally — 2FA included — and captures the `media-user-token` cookie
for you. Importing a `cookies.txt` still works, and the previous file is backed
up when it is replaced.

**Built for gamdl 3.x.** gamdl 2.9.3 could no longer parse Apple Music's
homepage, so this release targets 3.9 instead of patching the old version, and
exposes everything 3.x added:

- song codec priority (`alac` lossless, the AAC/Atmos/AC3 variants)
- folder & file naming templates (album, compilation, playlist, single /
  multi-disc, …)
- selectable DRM backend (`widevine` / `playready`) with `.wvd` / `.prd` devices
- synced-lyrics format (`lrc` / `srt` / `ttml`) and lyrics-only mode
- cover image format / size, M3U8 playlist export, filename truncation
- download database, log file, temp directory, external tool paths
- wrapper decryption settings (`--use-wrapper`, URL, decrypt host / port)

Options that 3.x removed (MP4Box / mp4decrypt paths, remux mode, …) are gone
from the UI too — gamdl now muxes and decrypts with its own bundled engine, so
neither `MP4Box` nor `mp4decrypt` is needed any more. Only `ffmpeg` is still
required, and only for the optional `nm3u8dlre` download mode.

**Self-contained downloads.** Each bundle contains the Qt interface *and* the
gamdl engine as two executables sharing one set of dependencies. Nothing to
install: unzip and run. The GUI always launches gamdl with `--no-config-file`,
so a stale `~/.gamdl/config.ini` can never override what you configured in the
app.

**English / 中文**, switchable on the fly, and the window size, theme, output
directory and every advanced option are remembered in `config.json`.

## Downloads

| Platform | Bundle |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ · Apple silicon | `Gamdl-GUI-macOS-arm64.zip` |
| macOS 11+ · Intel | `Gamdl-GUI-macOS-x86_64.zip` |
| Windows 10/11 · x64 | `Gamdl-GUI-Windows-x64.zip` |

Unzip and run — `Gamdl GUI.app` on macOS, `Gamdl GUI.exe` on Windows.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` is included.

> **macOS first launch.** The bundles are ad-hoc signed (no Apple Developer ID
> and no notarisation), so Gatekeeper blocks the first launch. Right-click the
> app → **Open** → **Open**, or clear the quarantine flag once:
>
> ```bash
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/path/to/Gamdl GUI.app"
> ```

## Notes

- You still need an Apple Music subscription, and the `media-user-token`
  cookie, to download. The GUI handles both.
- `ffmpeg` is only needed for the `nm3u8dlre` download mode; the default
  `ytdlp` mode needs nothing extra.
- Upgrading from an older build? The GUI reads your existing `config.json` and
  migrates the renamed options automatically.

## Verified

- A real download through the frozen bundle: an Apple Music track came out as
  AAC 261 kbps with an embedded cover, embedded lyrics, and a sidecar `.lrc`,
  finishing with `0 error(s)`.
- The macOS `.app` passes `codesign --verify --deep --strict`, and both the
  macOS and Windows bundles were built and smoke-tested on native CI runners.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carlchina/Gamdl_GUI/commits/v1.0.0
